title: From Creepy Suncatchers to Graphic T-Shirts, Here’s the Best ‘Obsession’ Merch Fans Are Buying Online
summary: Fans can't get enough of the horror movie and are even making its creepiest scenes part of their home decor.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Boy meets girl. Boy wishes girl would love him more than anyone in the whole world. Girl becomes obsessed with boy. The result? One of the year’s most talked-about movies, drawing audiences in with its unsettling “love” story.

Now streaming online , the Curry Barker thriller, with music by Rock Burwell, has quickly built a passionate fanbase, making it no surprise that merchandise inspired by the film is already everywhere. Official releases include graphic T-shirts featuring eerie artwork and memorable quotes from the movie, while independent creators have embraced the film with merch from creepy resin suncatchers and collectible mugs to stickers and tote bags.

Of course, no Obsession collection would feel complete without the infamous One Wish Willow — the plot-defining snap stick that plays such a pivotal role in the film (shop at your own risk).

GRAPHIC TEE

'Obsession' T-Shirt "Be Careful What You Wish For"

Limited-Time Deal

$17.99 $19.99 10% off

Buy Now On Amazon

This officially licensed shirt stands out thanks to its intentionally blurred font, making the warning difficult to read at first glance — a clever reference to the film’s frenzied theme.

It’s available in black across men’s, women’s, youth, tall and extra-small sizes with a classic lightweight fit and double-needle stitching. The shirt comes in several fabric blends depending on the color variation and is machine washable for easy everyday wear.

NIKKI SILHOUETTE

'Obsession' T-Shirt "What Would You Wish For?"

A haunting silhouette of Nikki framed in a doorway makes this official shirt one of the most striking pieces in the Obsession collection.

The black-and-white artwork pairs Nikki’s eerie figure with the question “What Would You Wish For?” Available in black across men’s, women’s, youth, tall and extra-small sizes, the lightweight shirt uses cotton or cotton-blend fabrics depending on the version and is machine washable. It’s also become a fan favorite, with more than 200 purchased on Amazon in the past month.

FUNKO POP

'Obsession' Bloody Nikki Funko Pop!

Preorder

$14.99

preorder Now at funko

Funko’s upcoming Bloody Nikki figure turns the film’s unforgettable villain into a collectible vinyl figure.

Standing approximately four inches tall, the Pop! recreates Nikki’s blood-soaked appearance in Funko’s signature style. The figure is currently available to preorder with an estimated December release, although the company notes that the final design may differ slightly from the early concept artwork shown in promotional images.

PHYSICAL RELEASE

'Obsession' 4K Disc

No. 1 Bestseller

$27.96

Experience Obsession in stunning detail with the Collector’s Edition 4K Ultra HD + Blu-ray + Digital.

The 4K Ultra HD disc delivers the sharpest picture with HDR (High Dynamic Range), while the Blu-ray offers crisp Full HD at 1080p playback. Furthermore, the digital copy allows you to download and stream the movie anywhere. The physical copy of the movie is a No. 1 Amazon bestseller, and over 20,000 copies have been purchased in the past month, alone.

NIKKI SUNCATCHER

'Obsession' Glass Suncatcher

Selling Fast

$91.00 $130.00 30% off

Buy Now on etsy

This handmade faux stained-glass suncatcher transforms Nikki into an eye-catching horror-inspired window display.

Available in resin or acrylic, the suncatcher comes in six, eight and 10-inch sizes with raised embossed details that create a realistic stained-glass effect without using actual glass. Each one includes a hanging chain and is designed for indoor display to help preserve the colors, making it one of the most unique fan-made Obsession collectibles currently available on Etsy.

WISHING STICK

One Wish Willow Snap Stick

$8.99

Inspired by the ancient wishing legend featured in Obsession , this 3D-printed novelty replica invites you to make one wish before snapping the stick in half, just like in the movie.

Each willow can only be broken once, reinforcing the film’s rules, and arrives in a retro-style presentation box that’s ideal for gifting. It’s currently a No. 1 bestseller on Amazon and even appeared on Jimmy Kimmel Live! when the host and Obsession star Inde Navarrette broke the willow and made the same wish.

GRAPHIC MUG

'Obsession' Nikki Mug "I Love My Girlfriend"

2 Sizes Available

$20.40 $22.67 10% off

This fan-made ceramic mug disguises one of the film’s creepiest characters behind an unexpectedly cute design.

Available in 11-ounce and 15-ounce sizes, the mug features a blood-covered Nikki inside a pink heart alongside the playful “I Love My Girlfriend” graphic. The contrast between the sweet artwork and the disturbing imagery makes it especially memorable for fans who understand the reference. It’s microwave- and dishwasher-safe, lead- and BPA-free and printed on durable white ceramic with vivid colors.

SCENES FROM THE MOVIE

'Obsession' Nikki & Bear Black Mug

$14.98 $19.98 25% off

This dramatic black mug shows Nikki and Bear through a collage of scenes inspired by the film’s darkest moments.

Available in both 11-ounce and 15-ounce versions, the glossy ceramic mug combines red, black and white artwork with high-quality sublimation printing. It’s microwave- and dishwasher-safe and comes with an easy-grip handle. The fan-made design isn’t official merchandise but still captures the unsettling chemistry between Nikki and Bear.

CREEPY STICKY NOTE

'Obsession' Sticky Note "My Little Food Critic"

$7.50

Only true Obsession fans will understand why this seemingly innocent sticker is actually one of the film’s darkest references.

At first glance, it looks like a sweet handwritten note, ideal for decorating laptops, notebooks or office spaces without giving away the joke. But actually, it references one of the movie’s most chilling scenes. Available in five sizes from two to six inches, buyers can choose laminated or non-laminated matte vinyl depending on where they plan to stick it, with custom versions also available from the seller.

TOTE BAG

'Obsession' One Wish Willow Tote Bag

Sale Ends Soon

$18.89 $26.99 30% off

Swap your usual handbag for an Obsession reference.

Available in black, red, natural and white, the made-to-order tote is designed for fans who want something more subtle than a graphic T-shirt. Since each bag is printed to order, returns are only accepted for damaged or incorrectly printed items.
